lineage: Arctic Wolf tracks Fog as a variant rather than a single cohesive group; early intrusions overlapped with Akira targeting of SonicWall SSL VPN
summary: Fog first surfaced in May 2024 against US education and recreation organisations, entering through compromised SSL VPN accounts (including SonicWall devices exposed to CVE-2024-40766) and later exploiting Veeam Backup & Replication CVE-2024-40711. Operators move fast: pass-the-hash to admin accounts, RDP to Hyper-V and Veeam servers, Veeam credential theft, Defender disabled, shadow copies deleted, and VMDK/backups encrypted, often within hours. In 2025 Fog campaigns added phishing with LNK-in-ZIP lures, the ktool BYOVD privilege-escalation utility (Intel iQVW64.sys) and unusual post-exploitation tooling (Syteca monitoring, GC2, Adaptix, Stowaway) in an Asian financial-sector intrusion.
uniqueTraits: SonicWall SSL VPN account abuse (CVE-2024-40766 era) shared with Akira
Veeam Backup & Replication CVE-2024-40711 exploitation to create a local admin, plus Veeam-Get-Creds.ps1
ktool.exe BYOVD using the vulnerable Intel iQVW64.sys driver (CVE-2015-2291)
'DOGE'-themed lures and lootsubmit.ps1 geolocation via the Wigle API
Use of Syteca employee-monitoring software and GC2 (Google Sheets C2) in 2025

chain.procedure: Logs in to SSL VPN gateways (two vendors, notably SonicWall SSLVPN accounts exposed by CVE-2024-40766) with compromised credentials and no MFA.
chain.noAtomicReason: Logon with stolen VPN/remote-access credentials has no local atomic; validate with VPN/IdP authentication telemetry (no MFA, unusual geo/ASN).

chain.procedure: 2025 campaigns send a 'Pay Adjustment' ZIP containing a malicious LNK that launches PowerShell.

atomics.note: LNK-triggered payload download, matching the LNK-in-ZIP lure.

chain.procedure: stage1.ps1 downloads cwiper.exe (loader), ktool.exe, lootsubmit.ps1 and trackerjacker.ps1.

atomics.note: PowerShell file download of next-stage components.

chain.procedure: ktool.exe drops the embedded vulnerable Intel network diagnostic driver iQVW64.sys to %TEMP% and abuses it (target PID + key) to elevate/kill processes.

atomics.testName: Scattered Spider BYOVD (CVE-2015-2291 for Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver)
atomics.note: Loads the same vulnerable Intel Ethernet diagnostics driver (iQVW64.sys, CVE-2015-2291).

chain.procedure: lootsubmit.ps1 collects IP/MAC/hardware details and geolocates the host via the Wigle API, posting results to a Netlify-hosted endpoint.

atomics.testName: Get geolocation info through IP-Lookup services using curl Windows
atomics.note: IP-lookup geolocation via curl from Windows.

chain.procedure: The loader checks hardware specs, registry keys, tick counts and MAC values to detect analysis environments.

atomics.testName: Detect Virtualization Environment via WMI Manufacturer/Model Listing (Windows)

chain.procedure: Exploits Veeam Backup & Replication CVE-2024-40711 (URI on port 8000) to spawn net.exe and create a local administrator account.

atomics.testName: Create a new Windows admin user
atomics.note: Creates a new local Windows admin user, the post-exploit action of CVE-2024-40711.

atomics.testName: Create a new user in a command prompt
atomics.note: net user account creation from cmd.

chain.procedure: Runs Veeam-Get-Creds.ps1 to recover passwords from the Veeam Backup & Replication credentials manager.
chain.noAtomicReason: No local atomic reads the Veeam credential store; detect PowerShell access to the Veeam configuration database.

atomics.testName: Dump Active Directory Database with NTDSUtil
Copy NTDS.dit from Volume Shadow Copy
atomics.note: Copy NTDS.dit from a volume shadow copy.

chain.techniqueName: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Hash
chain.procedure: Pass-the-hash against administrator accounts, then RDP to Hyper-V and Veeam servers; credential stuffing also suspected.
SoftPerfect Network Scanner and Advanced Port Scanner enumerate hosts and services.
SharpShares v2.3 enumerates accessible network shares.

atomics.testName: Enumerate All Network Shares with SharpShares
atomics.note: Enumerate all network shares with SharpShares.

chain.procedure: RDP to Windows servers running Hyper-V and Veeam.
PsExec used for remote execution and to transfer tooling over admin shares.

atomics.note: Copy and execute file with PsExec.

chain.techniqueName: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
chain.procedure: Disables Windows Defender on servers touched by the operators.

atomics.testName: Tamper with Windows Defender Command Prompt
atomics.note: Tamper with Windows Defender from cmd (catalogue ID T1685).

atomics.testName: Tamper with Windows Defender ATP PowerShell
atomics.note: Tamper with Windows Defender via PowerShell.

chain.procedure: 2025 financial-sector intrusion used GC2 (C2 over Google Sheets/SharePoint), Adaptix C2, the Stowaway proxy and the Syteca employee-monitoring product; operators retained access after encryption.
chain.noAtomicReason: No local atomic emulates Google Sheets/SharePoint-based C2 (GC2) or Syteca abuse; detect via proxy logs to Sheets API and unsanctioned monitoring-agent installs.

chain.procedure: vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet; Veeam object-storage backups deleted.
Prioritises VMDK files in VM storage; encrypted files renamed .FOG/.FLOCKED with readme.txt note (2025 notes mock DOGE).
